doctrines.name: A: Yveltal control-chip (primary)
doctrines.plan: reserve 2 Prism for one Yveltal, NZ lock, chip 110/turn, take 6 prizes (exes give 2 each) while immune
doctrines.discriminating_metric: energy_attach_share[16(Prism)->689]; A requires Prism concentrated on Yveltal (>=0.7 of Prism attaches to 689). If Prism spreads to Comfey/Shaymin -> type-death

doctrines.name: B: resource-lock deckout (backup)
doctrines.plan: if opponent board too tanky for prize race, full energy+hand lock and win by OPPONENT deckout; requires NOT using Comfey-215 and NOT over-drawing ourselves
doctrines.discriminating_metric: loss_share[deckout] ours vs opp AND our deckCount at end; if our deckout>>opp, B is self-defeating -> revert to A

doctrines.name: PlanB: Prism lost
doctrines.plan: if Prism prized/discarded (Yveltal 998 unreachable), chip with Comfey-216 (20-40) + Shaymin (30) under NZ immunity and lean on lock/deckout
doctrines.discriminating_metric: play_rate[689 attack 998]; if ~0, confirm Prism availability (Night Stretcher recovery fire)

tensions.balance: fire searchers/draw only when a needed piece is missing (possession-based) AND deckCount > K (K in {8..12}); the engine that finds NZ/Prism is the same engine that decks us out
use Comfey-215 only while hand_size<H AND we are on prize-plan; on deckout-plan 215 is forbidden (it draws opponent 3)
Prism attaches to 689 until one Yveltal has 2 Prism; only a genuinely spare 3rd Prism may fill Comfey/Shaymin colorless
always attack (passivity punished) but pick Boss targets by real-KO value; never expose/discard NZ for tempo (ACE SPEC, unrecoverable from discard)

hypotheses.claim: Unconditional use of the 5 draw/search cards (+Comfey-215) decks US out before we win; the control win is slow and the draw engine is the deckout clock
hypotheses.direction: our deckout loss share must be LOW and below opponent's
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: gating searchers too hard starves the deck of NZ/Prism/board and prevents the lock from ever forming (no setup = slow loss anyway)
hypotheses.scenario: Opponent plays passively/durdles. L0 fires Pokegear+PokePad+Poffin+Night Stretcher+Colress every turn and attacks with Comfey-215 -> our deck empties; PROBED: against a do-nothing opponent we self-decked and LOST 27/40 games, deck hitting 0 around engine-turn 51-95.

l2_rationale: L0 will (a) attach wrong-TYPE energy to Yveltal (type-death, H2), (b) self-deckout by firing all searchers unconditionally (H1, both PROBE-CONFIRMED catastrophic), (c) mis-prioritize/discard the single ACE-SPEC lock (H4), and (d) mis-gate every disruption/gust card (H7,H8). The win path is grind/energy-denial, not a prize race, so the generic 'load best-display attacker and swing' policy is actively harmful. L2 required.
